definition: Throughout this document, local boards of health are referred to as either “boards of health” or “boards.” Unless otherwise specified, these terms include local departments of health, public health commissions, and regional health districts.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)

definition: “Department” means the Massachusetts Department of Public Health, unless otherwise indicated.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)

definition: The State Sanitary Code is a series of public health regulations promulgated by the Department of Public Health that specify minimum sanitation standards.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)

definition: Private beaches are those that are not considered public or semi-public beaches, as defined in 105 CMR 445.010.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)

definition: A noisome trade is a slaughter house, melting or rendering establishment, or any other offensive trade or establishment.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)

term: conduct not deemed to constitute a nuisance
definition: However, the odor from the normal maintenance of livestock or the spreading of manure upon agricultural and horticultural or farming lands, or noise from livestock or farm equipment used in normal, generally acceptable farming procedures or from plowing or cultivation operations upon agricultural and horticultural or farming lands shall not be deemed to constitute a nuisance.
source_document: Massachusetts Association of Health Boards, Manual of Laws and Regulations Relating to Boards of Health, June 2016 (KB 2/USA/MAHB-updated-Manual-of-Laws-and-Regulations-6.17.16-1.pdf)
